objective: Make the existing opt-in Adult control provide real broad adult-domain DPI coverage and validate full HTTP page access instead of merely probing one site.

findings.claim: Adult toggle was enabled on both installed Windows and Linux hosts but only controlled a Pornhub live probe; it did not expand DPI host coverage.
Built-in v1.5.0 adult scope contains pornhub.com and phncdn.com but omits xvideos.com, xnxx.com, xhamster.com and many other adult domains.
With normal v1.5.0 balanced/targeted state, Pornhub and RedTube return HTTP 200 on both hosts while Xvideos/XNXX/XHamster fail during TLS before HTTP.

On Linux, controlled temporary inclusion of xvideos.com and xnxx.com under the existing Balanced profile changed both from TLS failure/HTTP 000 to HTTP 200; rollback restored the prior Reddit custom-host configuration and ACTIVE balanced/targeted state.
XHamster remained failing under Balanced, Strong, Compatibility and six bounded candidate TCP-443 strategies; no unproven strategy is promoted.

Current HaGeZi NSFW only-domains upstream was fetched independently on 2026-10-05: 84,135 physical lines / 1,330,723 bytes, SHA-256 68579D46894EEAFF2D52C793C4163A2C5CA8409FD28DFB71A179768663450DE9; validation yields 84,123 non-comment domain entries and includes xvideos.com, xnxx.com, xhamster.com, pornhub.com and redtube.com.

Gemini returns HTTP 403 for /, /app, /app?hl=en and /?hl=en under browser-like IPv4 probes; IPv6 is unavailable for this path. A normal isolated Edge-browser check from the earlier same change set also rendered the 403 rather than a usable Gemini page.

Cloudflare trace classifies the current public egress as IR. Google official Gemini web availability lists Azerbaijan and over 230 supported countries/territories, but no Iran entry was found. DPI manipulation does not change public egress geolocation.

Fresh isolated Microsoft Edge CDP validation on the Windows v1.5.0 active host confirms user-visible failure for XVideos and XHamster: both finish at chrome-error://chromewebdata/ with navigation responseStatus 0 and transferSize 0. Gemini independently completes navigation at gemini.google.com with HTTP 403.

Comparable zapret projects consistently pair major adult site domains with CDN/companion families; representative families include xvideos-cdn.com/xvcdn.com, xnxx-cdn.com, xhcdn.com/xhamsterlive.com, phncdn.com/phprcdn.com, rdtcdn.com, ypncdn.com and sb-cd.com. These were promoted only to the offline fallback host coverage, not to a new unproven DPI strategy.

HaGeZi officially publishes the same NSFW only-domains catalog through both raw GitHub and jsDelivr. Windows and Linux candidate code now fail over between those two official endpoints while applying identical size/domain validation before accepting data.

AloofLibra/zator includes XHamster in its adaptive sweep corpus and defines strategy 28 as multidisorder with split positions 1,host+2,sld+2,sld+5,sniext+1,sniext+2,endhost-2 and seqovl=1. The corresponding classic nfqws v72.13 command line passes dry-run on the installed Linux runtime, proving syntax/engine compatibility only; network effectiveness remains UNPROVEN.

Official zapret v72.13 release archive was downloaded to the Linux test host and matched upstream SHA-256 25C74E6C5F48963FA244C2955E76694A07C39447245A0457E2EFDC74B3317E68. Its blockcheck tool is ready in /tmp, but full quick-scan requires root firewall mutation; pkexec waits for interactive authorization and sudo -n is not allowed on the laptop connector.
Official zapret v72.13 release archive was downloaded from the upstream release and SHA-256 matched 25C74E6C5F48963FA244C2955E76694A07C39447245A0457E2EFDC74B3317E68 before strategy research.

When Direct Method is off, the validation network DNS can return interception addresses such as 10.10.34.35; with owned ctrld DoH active, xhamster.com resolved to public Cloudflare addresses 104.16.3.81/104.16.4.81.

An isolated HTTPS-only zapret v72.13 matrix using a separate nft/NFQUEUE probe found no usable full-page XHamster strategy: several split/sequence-overlap/syndata variants reached HTTP 520 on 104.16.4.81 while 104.16.3.81 remained TLS-failing. HTTP 520 is not accepted as PASS.

Do not add GreenTunnel, SpoofDPI or PowerTunnel runtimes because they use local proxy architectures; do not add GoodbyeDPI because its direct fragmentation/DNS anti-poisoning primitives materially overlap the already accepted zapret/winws runtime without demonstrated incremental benefit.

PR #20 protected CI run 37350996926 failed only in Linux release_metadata_audit because SHA256SUMS.txt was CRLF in the Windows worktree (SHA C95F...) but canonical Git checkout normalized it to LF (SHA 6C3B...). All Linux/adult/router contracts passed before this metadata failure.
findings.rootCause: Checksum artifact self-hash was computed from non-canonical Windows worktree bytes despite .gitattributes specifying LF for root SHA256SUMS.txt.
findings.prevention: Canonicalize root and delivery SHA256SUMS.txt to LF, mark both text eol=lf, and record the canonical LF checksum artifact SHA in RELEASE.json.

findings.claim: Exact installed Linux v1.5.1 lifecycle PASSed three real cycles with rollbackEqual=true and restored the initially ACTIVE state. YouTube/OpenAI/GitHub remained PASS; Reddit passed when explicitly targeted and under All Sites; representative adult page passed HTTP 200 under Strong/All Sites.

Comparable-project candidate fake+md5sig+TTL=6 was tested with a correctly wired isolated nft/NFQUEUE harness against both xhamster.com Cloudflare edges 104.16.3.81 and 104.16.4.81. Both remained TLS-failing (HTTP 000), so the profile is not promoted.

Bare xhamster.com and www.xhamster.com resolve to the same Cloudflare edge pair 104.16.3.81/104.16.4.81 under owned DoH and both remain TLS-failing; canonical-hostname variation does not close the blocker.

decision.claim: For Adult coverage, convert the existing opt-in toggle into a real coverage control. Fetch and validate a maintained upstream domain catalog at runtime instead of redistributing it in the release, keep a small built-in fallback for major families, and apply the adult hostlist only when enabled.
decision.rationale: This gives broad maintained coverage without pretending a small hard-coded list means all sites, avoids GPL list redistribution inside the release, and preserves default privacy/minimum-scope behavior.

constraints: Do not change Windows network state during source development; Windows is currently ACTIVE and healthy.
Linux is the mutation test host; preserve and restore its prior custom hosts and ACTIVE balanced/targeted state.
No global Strong/Compatibility promotion because tests showed regressions.
Gemini egress-policy remediation is a separate architecture decision because it requires changing egress.
Do not label Gemini HTTP 403 as PASS/REACHABLE success; usable-page acceptance requires 2xx/3xx.
Do not claim all adult sites are individually proven merely because a maintained catalog contains them; prove representative families and preserve fallback/custom-site paths.
Broad Adult domain coverage may be promoted with representative proof and truthful limitations; do not claim every remote Adult origin/CDN edge is guaranteed.
exactNextAction: Promote installed Linux acceptance and lifecycle test to the branch, require final-head protected CI, then continue unresolved XHamster/Gemini research without weakening accepted broad-coverage/runtime claims.
